archetype: ORGANIC & EARTHY mixed with SWISS HIGH-CONTRAST

rules: NEVER use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings.
Headlines > 32px MUST use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight or tighter).
Overlines/Labels MUST be Uppercase, Tiny, and Wide Spacing.

layouts.spacing_system: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use 2-3x more spacing. p-8, p-12 for containers.
layouts.dashboard_grid: MODE B: High Density Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Tight gap-6.
layouts.marketing_grid: MODE A: The 'Tetris' Grid for landing sections. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8.
rules: Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision.

surfaces.dashboard_cards: Flat solid surfaces with crisp 1px borders (border-border or #E2E8F0). NO drop shadows. rounded-xl.
surfaces.headers: Solid Background with a hard bottom border, no glassmorphism for this specific app to maintain a clean SaaS feel.
surfaces.inputs: Shadcn inputs customized with solid backgrounds (#F8FAFC) and subtle borders on focus.

motion.interactions: Hover states must translate-y-[-2px] and slightly darken border color. Micro-interactions for buttons.
motion.live_analysis: Use framer-motion to create a 'scanning' effect: a pulsating loader, staggered reveal of AI engines being queried, and glowing progress indicators.
motion.page_transitions: Fade-in and slight slide-up (y: 20 -> 0) for dashboard entrance.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or slightly rounded (rounded-lg). Primary buttons use #064E3B. MUST have clear hover states.
components.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select. Customize to remove standard Vercel look by adding generous padding (h-12) and soft focus rings (focus:ring-primary/20).
components.charts: Recharts. Use RadarChart for Visibility across Clusters. Use BarChart for Overall engine scores. Colors must use the app's accent and primary palette.
components.accordion: Use Shadcn Accordion for the list of AI-generated questions per cluster.

charts_strategy.radar_chart: Compare AI Knowledge vs Reality across clusters (Prayer Logistics, Community, Services, etc.). Fill color: primary with 20% opacity. Stroke: primary.
charts_strategy.bar_chart: Engine performance (Claude vs GPT vs Gemini). Use different shades of primary and accent colors.

hero_background.description: Zayed Sheikh Mosque, used for marketing hero section overlay.

feature_1.description: Muslim cafe owner, used to illustrate 'Muslim Businesses'.

feature_2.description: Halal food spread, used for category illustration.

accessibility.contrast: Text below 18px MUST have 4.5:1 ratio. Large text 3:1.
accessibility.focus: Focus states must have HIGHER contrast than default.
accessibility.aria: All interactive elements must have appropriate aria-labels.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup Tailwind with provided color palette and Google Fonts.
2. Build the Landing Hero section using a split layout or bento grid, utilizing the hero_background image.
3. Build the Analysis Form (Entity Name, Location, Category, URL).
4. Create a realistic Live Analysis loading state using framer-motion (simulate querying Claude, GPT, Gemini).
5. Build the Dashboard: Overall Score (large typography), Radar Chart for clusters, Accordion list of missing questions.
6. Use recharts for the data visualization.
7. Include a 'Download PDF Audit' button (can be a mocked action with a toast notification).
8. Apply data-testid to all interactive elements.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not converge toward generic AI slop. Make creative, distinctive frontends.
No pure black or pure white unless specified. Use off-whites and tinted darks.
DO NOT apply universal transitions (transition: all). Target specific properties.
DO NOT center align the app container. Respect natural reading flow.
NEVER use placeholder URLs (via.placeholder.com). Use the provided image_urls.
Use lucide-react for icons. Do NOT use emojis as icons.
